matchstick.title: Prefer intra-character stick relocation
matchstick.principle: When trying to fix the equation, first attempt to move a single matchstick within the same character before considering moves between characters.
matchstick.when_to_apply: At the start of solving, try moving a stick inside a character (e.g., X→V) before exploring inter-character relocations.
matchstick.example: Moving a stick from one character to another when a simple intra-character move could have solved the puzzle, leading to unnecessary complexity.

matchstick.title: Validate symbols after stick move
matchstick.principle: After relocating a stick, verify that each resulting character corresponds to a valid Roman numeral or operator.
matchstick.when_to_apply: Immediately after any stick relocation, check each character's shape against the set of allowed symbols.
matchstick.example: After moving a stick, ending up with a character that is not a valid Roman numeral, such as a single diagonal stick.

matchstick.title: Avoid single angled sticks
matchstick.principle: A solitary diagonal stick does not represent any Roman numeral; ensure that removing a diagonal from X or V leaves a valid character.
matchstick.when_to_apply: Whenever a diagonal stick is removed from a character, confirm that the remaining sticks form a valid numeral (e.g., X→V).
matchstick.example: Removing a diagonal from X and leaving a lone diagonal, which does not correspond to any numeral.

matchstick.title: Consider inter-character stick relocation
matchstick.principle: If no intra-character move yields a valid equation, explore moving a stick from one character to another.
matchstick.when_to_apply: After exhausting intra-character possibilities without success, try moving a stick between distinct characters.
matchstick.example: Only trying intra-character moves and failing to consider moving a stick from one character to another, missing a valid solution.

matchstick.title: Verify arithmetic after stick move
matchstick.principle: Compute the numeric values of both sides of the equation after any transformation; the equality must hold.
matchstick.when_to_apply: After a candidate transformation produces valid symbols, evaluate the arithmetic to confirm the equation is true.
matchstick.example: Accepting a transformation that yields valid symbols but the arithmetic doesn't hold (e.g., 11 = 16).

matchstick.title: Preserve equality sign after stick relocation
matchstick.principle: If a stick is taken from the '=' sign, ensure the remaining symbol still forms a valid equality sign.
matchstick.when_to_apply: When considering moving a stick from '=', verify that the sign remains a double horizontal line.
matchstick.example: Taking a stick from the '=' sign and leaving a single horizontal line, resulting in no equality sign in the equation.

matchstick.title: Validate whole numeral strings for proper Roman numeral syntax
matchstick.principle: After any stick move, verify that each multi-character numeral follows standard Roman numeral ordering rules.
matchstick.when_to_apply: After adjusting characters, check that each numeral string is syntactically correct (e.g., no 'IIV' or 'VX').
matchstick.example: Forming an invalid numeral like 'IIV' or 'VX' after a stick move, violating Roman numeral syntax.

matchstick.title: Intra-character diagonal transformation (V↔X)
matchstick.principle: When a character is V or X (both composed of two diagonal sticks), moving one diagonal within the same character can change V to X or X to V.
matchstick.when_to_apply: If the puzzle involves X or V, try moving a diagonal within that character to toggle between the two shapes.
matchstick.example: Moving a diagonal from X but not repositioning it to form a V, leaving an invalid single diagonal.

matchstick.title: Transform '+' to '-' by moving its vertical stick to an adjacent I
matchstick.principle: If a '+' operator and an adjacent 'I' numeral are present, moving the vertical stick from '+' to the 'I' turns '+' into '-' and creates an extra 'I'.
matchstick.when_to_apply: When a '+' is next to an 'I' and a reduction of the left side is needed, consider moving the vertical stick to the 'I'.
matchstick.example: Moving the vertical stick from '+' to a non-adjacent location, creating a stray vertical stick and not forming a valid 'I'.

matchstick.title: Intra-character operator transformation (e.g., '+' → '=', '-' → '=') by rotating a stick within the same operator
matchstick.principle: Operators can be changed by rotating a stick within the same character; for example, turning '+' into '=' or '-' into '='.
matchstick.when_to_apply: When an operator needs to be altered, first try rotating or repositioning its sticks internally before moving sticks to other characters.
matchstick.example: Rotating a stick within '+' incorrectly, resulting in an invalid operator shape that is neither '+' nor '='.

matchstick.description: Overlooking intra‑character transformations (e.g., X→V) before inter‑character moves
matchstick.why_it_happens: The model tends to consider moving sticks between characters first, missing simpler solutions that involve reshaping a single character.
matchstick.how_to_avoid: First attempt intra‑character stick relocations, especially diagonal transformations like X↔V, before exploring inter‑character moves.

matchstick.description: Leaving a single angled stick after moving a diagonal from X or V (invalid numeral)
matchstick.why_it_happens: When a diagonal is removed from X or V, the remaining single diagonal does not correspond to any Roman numeral, but the model may overlook this.
matchstick.how_to_avoid: Ensure that after removing a diagonal, the source character still forms a valid numeral (e.g., X→V) rather than leaving a lone diagonal.

matchstick.description: Not evaluating the arithmetic result after each candidate transformation
matchstick.why_it_happens: The model may focus on symbol validity without checking whether the resulting equation is numerically correct.
matchstick.how_to_avoid: After any stick move, compute the numeric values of both sides and verify the equality.

matchstick.description: Overlooking intra‑character operator transformations (e.g., '+' → '=', '-' → '=') and assuming operator changes require moving sticks between characters
matchstick.why_it_happens: The model assumes operators can only be changed by moving sticks to other characters, missing intra‑character rotations.
matchstick.how_to_avoid: Consider rotating or repositioning sticks within the operator itself to change its type before moving sticks elsewhere.

matchstick.description: Omitting the equality sign in the final answer
matchstick.why_it_happens: The model may forget to include the '=' sign when outputting the final corrected equation.
matchstick.how_to_avoid: Always include the equality sign in the final answer line, preserving the format 'Correct version of the equation: <equation>'.
